selection: scan ascending independent deal seeds; first eligible min-hand-pips discovery position with prior empty-stock pass by next opponent, >=3 canonical ordinary singles, <=6 hidden opponent stones; >=6 compatible hidden allocations; first 30 eligible
findings: Out-of-sample replication only; do not infer a human rule or causality. History-based pass forecast does not necessarily improve win-oriented action selection.
limitations: Selection on late-game states and first eligible position, small train/test within each visible position, model assumed branch-opening semantics, fixed bot continuations, block winner unassigned, canonical singles only; position-level normal-approx intervals exploratory; hidden worlds equal-weighted not posterior on all opponent decisions.
